text: It has been suggested that Egil Skallagrimsson may have had Paget's Disease. Pagets Disease causes human bone cells to reproduce faster than they are destroyed. The skull of a person with Pagets Disease can therefore be large and quite heavy. Thorðr Harðarson, a medical doctor, first suggested this hypothesis in an Icelandic journal in 1984. This hypothesis fits well with the descriptions of Egils physical appearance and his conditions found in Egils Saga. According to the saga, the final resting place of Egils bones was changed a final time when they were moved from the church at Hrísbrú to the new Mosfell church.
